prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Valeria, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Valeria thinks the municipal pool has been badly maintained for years.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "They’re shutting down the municipal pool all summer because the water is officially toxic. Given how they’ve neglected that place for years, it’s definitely not safe for anyone to swim there."
text: The municipal pool is being condemned for the entire summer because the water is literally a toxic, hazardous waste dump. It was only a matter of time before their years of total neglect turned the place into a death trap for our families.
